card.text: A-type star 7.70 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Fomalhaut is an A-type star 7.70 parsecs away and 1.84 times the Sun’s radius, known for its debris ring. Here its surface is a plain sphere.

shape.title: Sphere of the measured radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
